refuses FLAC input before decoding, untimed and timed

details: 800 exact byte comparisons of f32le/f64le raw and framecrc output: 5 stereo source formats x 5 chains (incl. asetnsamples splits and doubled aintegral) x 6 time scenarios (none, output -ss, -t, -ss+-t, -ss+-frames:a, input -ss/-t) x 2 I/O budgets
360 exact byte comparisons of s16le, framecrc and WAV output with -cpuflags 0 from low-amplitude zero-mean input (integral within +-1), 5 source formats x 4 chains x 6 scenarios
3 native exit-status comparisons for refusals: aintegral=foo=1 (native 8), aintegral=enable=1 (native 0), integral beyond 32768 into s16 (native 0, clips)

unsupported: automatic sample-rate conversion around the step
float-to-integer output where the integral exceeds the scalar conversion bound of 32768 (native clips)
s16 output beyond integrals within +-1 is not claimed; u8 and s32 encoder output not compared

proposedContracts.name: matches native aintegral f32 and f64 output for every source format, frame split and output time selection
proposedContracts.scope: f32/f64 raw and framecrc output from u8/s16/s32/f32/f64 stereo input, five chains with asetnsamples splits, output -ss/-t/-frames:a and input trim; Linux x64 reference.

proposedContracts.name: matches native aintegral s16 output with -cpuflags 0 from low-amplitude zero-mean input whose integral stays within one
proposedContracts.scope: s16le, framecrc and WAV output with -cpuflags 0 from low-amplitude zero-mean input whose integral stays within +-1; Linux x64 reference.

proposedContracts.name: refuses aintegral options, timeline enable, and integer output beyond the scalar conversion bound before writing output
proposedContracts.scope: Explicit CLI refusals with exact messages and no output, against native exit status.

proposedContracts.name: matches the C transcription across frames and frame splits for float and double
proposedContracts.scope: INTEGRAL(flt/dbl) loop transcription with the accumulator carried across five frame splits, 1-3 channels.

notes: af_aderivative.c has no individual copyright line; NOTICE-AINTEGRAL states this.
Native's initial prev buffer behaves as zero (verified by the differential tests).

reserve() declares channels*8 stateBytes: the accumulator is a Float64Array for both fltp and dblp, so it is exact even when a later list (e.g. volume=precision=double) makes the step negotiate dblp from non-double input.

FLAC refusal is pinned in the unit test via compileFlacTransform; in this sandbox the CLI FLAC path fails earlier with 'FLAC codec module is not configured' because edge-flac.wasm cannot be built (downloads.xiph.org blocked).
No other shared edit was needed.
Setup durations: submodule 41 s, npm ci 7 s, reference:build 175 s, baseline static checks 59 s, baseline unit suite 80 s.
